incoming.name: Computer
incoming.excerpt: Graphics processors and computers with SIMD and MIMD features often provide ALUs that can perform arithmetic on vectors and matrices.

incoming.name: Gottfried Leibniz

outgoing.name: Carl Friedrich Gauss
outgoing.excerpt: Carl Friedrich Gauss and Wilhelm Jordan developed Gauss-Jordan elimination in the 1800s.

outgoing.name: Gottfried Leibniz
outgoing.excerpt: Leibniz, one of the two founders of calculus, developed the theory of determinants in 1693.

outgoing.name: John von Neumann
outgoing.excerpt: Cayley, Hamilton, Grassmann, Frobenius and von Neumann are among the famous mathematicians who have worked on matrix theory.

outgoing.name: World War II
outgoing.excerpt: Olga Taussky Todd (1906-1995) started to use matrix theory when investigating an aerodynamic phenomenon called fluttering or aeroelasticity, during WWII.
